fields.description: The opaque docname series. Nothing about the volunteer, the branches or the date goes in the primary key.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: Who is moving. Identity is read through their Red Profile and never copied onto this record; what moves is their placement, which is the only thing this record touches.
fields.label: Volunteer

fields.description: Where the volunteer is placed today, snapshotted from their record when this transfer is raised rather than typed in. It is also the ACC-02 anchor: geo scoping and, where a society routes transfers, approval routing both read it, so the branch currently responsible for the volunteer is the branch that sees and authorises their release. A society that would rather the receiving branch decide points its approval workflow's geo_node_field at to_geo_node instead, which needs no code change. This node never moves afterwards, which is what keeps a completed transfer a record of where somebody came from.
fields.label: From

fields.description: Where the volunteer is moving to. Must be a different node from the one they are at, and must sit at the level this society places volunteers at (ACC-03, vmms_volunteer_anchor_level), because after the transfer this becomes their home_geo_node and has to satisfy the same rule their placement always did.
fields.label: To

fields.description: The day the volunteer is treated as belonging to the new branch. A date today or in the past takes effect on the next save once approval is settled; a date in the future waits for the daily sweep, so a transfer arranged in advance happens on the day it was arranged for and not on the day it was typed.
fields.label: Effective Date

fields.description: Where this transfer is in its life, as distinct from where its approval is. Pending is a transfer that has not moved anybody yet, whatever its approval says. Effective is one that has: the volunteer's home_geo_node now names the new branch. Cancelled is a transfer the society called off, and it is terminal. A closed, code owned set, written by deployment/services/transfer.py and never by hand.
fields.label: Transfer Status

fields.description: When the volunteer's placement was actually moved. Written once, and it is what makes applying a transfer idempotent: a second attempt sees the stamp and does nothing rather than moving somebody twice. Empty on a transfer that has not taken effect.
fields.label: Applied On

fields.description: Why the volunteer is moving, in the requester's own words. Required, because a transfer changes who can see somebody and who approves for them, and a change of that kind with no reason recorded is one nobody can review afterwards. Read by whoever approves it; never read by code.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: The approval engine's state. Owned entirely by vmmsx/approvals: this doctype declares the field and never writes it. It stays at Draft where a society has not asked for transfers to be routed, which is deliberate: the absence of an approval is not an approval, and what governs whether the placement moves is the settled predicate rather than a state somebody set. docstatus is deliberately unused.
fields.label: Approval State
fields.options:
Draft
Submitted
In Review
Approved
Rejected
Withdrawn
Expired

fields.description: The opaque row name of the approval stage under review. Engine owned; never a stage's label, so relabelling a stage changes a screen and nothing else.
fields.label: Approval Stage

fields.description: When the current stage was entered, and the SLA clock the approval engine measures a breach against.
fields.label: Stage Entered On

fields.description: The approval audit trail: who decided what, at which stage, when and why. Written only by the engine.
fields.label: Approval Decisions
